description: This script provides IP address calculations, including conversions between dotted decimal and integer notation, subnet calculations, and IP range analysis. It appears to be a utility for IP subnetting and address management, likely used within a larger network configuration or diagnostic context.

methods.name: bitcount
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in a 32-bit integer, used to compute subnet prefix length.

methods.name: ip2int
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address from dotted decimal notation to a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: int2ip
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer back to dotted decimal IPv4 notation.

methods.name: compl32
methods.description: Computes the 32-bit complement of a given value, typically used for subnet masking.
